# lifesim-r32: personality R7: facets stored as band text, first-sorted trait wins
bug · P2 · auto, lane:creator, no-sandbox

## Description
## Goal
Facets and values are stored as numbers per personality.R7, not band text with first-sorted trait winning.
## Context
GenomeWriter.cs (Seeds, ~line 45-62) stores a facet band as text and lets the trait whose id sorts first win. personality.R7 (accepted) wants a number at the middle of the seeding traits' bands, drawn by the save's seed within content/traits/knobs.yaml#personality.seed_spread, neutral when unseeded. content/traits/knobs.yaml does not exist: add it with PLACEHOLDER band edges and seed_spread (numbers live only in content) and record the scale choice as a decision (decided_by: session). The genome is saved in the household file: bump its format and keep reading old files (src/Sim.Core/Saves/HouseholdFile.cs). Owned by the character-creator code (src/Sim.Core/Modules/CharacterCreator).
## Done when
- A scenario for personality R7 passes: two traits seeding one facet give a number inside both bands; an unseeded facet is neutral; same picks and seed give identical numbers.
- Old household files still load.
- just check green.
